    /* ==================== 1. ANIMATED TITLE GRADIENT FLOW ==================== */
    .flow-rect {
      animation: colorFlow 5s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes colorFlow {
      0% { transform: translateX(-400px); }
      100% { transform: translateX(400px); }
    }

    /* ==================== 2. DATA POINTS STREAMING ==================== */
    .data-point-cyan {
      animation: streamLeftToRight 10s linear infinite;
    }
    .data-point-purple {
      animation: streamLeftToRight 12s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes streamLeftToRight {
      0% { transform: translateX(-80px); opacity: 0; }
      10% { opacity: 0.65; }
      90% { opacity: 0.65; }
      100% { transform: translateX(960px); opacity: 0; }
    }

    /* ==================== 3. TRAINING CLASSIFICATION BOUNDARY ==================== */
    .training-wave {
      animation: waveFlow 7s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes waveFlow {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-180px); }
    }

    /* ==================== 4. NEURAL NETWORK NODES & SYNAPSES ==================== */
    .node-pulse-1 {
      animation: nodePulse 3.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }
    .node-pulse-2 {
      animation: nodePulse 4.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate 1s;
    }
    .synapse-flicker-1 {
      animation: synapseFlicker 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }
    .synapse-flicker-2 {
      animation: synapseFlicker 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate 0.7s;
    }
    @keyframes nodePulse {
      0% { opacity: 0.4; r: 2px; }
      50% { opacity: 1; r: 3.2px; }
      100% { opacity: 0.5; r: 2px; }
    }
    @keyframes synapseFlicker {
      0% { opacity: 0.15; }
      50% { opacity: 0.45; }
      100% { opacity: 0.15; }
    }

    /* ==================== 5. TERMINAL COMMANDS CYCLE ==================== */
    .terminal-line {
      font-family: Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-size: 11.5px;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }
    .cmd-cursor {
      animation: cursorBlink 0.8s step-start infinite;
    }
    @keyframes cursorBlink {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0; }
    }

    /* Staggered Command Transitions (6 commands cycling smoothly) */

    @keyframes assembleSequence {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.4); }

      80% { opacity: 0.7; transform: scale(1.02); }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1); pointer-events: none; }
